description: This file contains utility functions and an API call implementation for the MiniMax VLM image understanding service, including provider/model checks, URL coercion, and fetch request handling with error processing.

methods.name: isMinimaxVlmProvider
methods.description: Checks if the provider string is 'minimax' or 'minimax-portal'.

methods.name: isMinimaxVlmModel
methods.description: Checks if the provider is a minimax VLM provider and the model ID matches 'MiniMax-VL-01'.

methods.name: coerceApiHost
methods.description: Determines the API host URL based on provided parameters or environment variables, with fallback to a default URL.

methods.name: pickString
methods.description: Safely extracts a string value from a record by key.

methods.name: minimaxUnderstandImage
methods.description: Performs an API call to understand an image based on prompt and image data URL, with error handling and response validation.
